prompt.alinti: If you're an AI developer, you need to check out this GitHub repo.
It's basically 230 plus AI agents packed into one place.
I'm talking front-end, back-end, AI, DevOps, cybersecurity, marketing, and pretty much everything else you can think of.
These aren't just basic AI prompts. Every agent has its own role, specialized workflow, and expertise to handle specific tasks.
You can use them with AI coding tools like Cloud Code, Cursor, and Codex, all with just a single prompt.
Instead of building your own AI agents from scratch,
you can use these ready-made agents to speed up your entire workflow.
